title: LangChain open-sources the paid-media agent behind its campaign workflow
friendlyTitle: LangChain shares the AI agent it uses for advertising work
summary: LangChain has published the architecture and code for an agent that combines advertising and sales data, prepares weekly reports, proposes campaign changes and routes them through human approval. The company says moving calculations and safeguards into code made one reporting workflow 13 times faster and about 40 times cheaper.
friendlySummary: The agent studies ad and sales data, writes reports and suggests changes for a person to approve. LangChain has released its code.
whyItMatters: The practical lesson travels beyond advertising: use models for judgement, ordinary code for repeatable calculations, and explicit approval before external changes. The released project offers teams a concrete starting point, although LangChain’s performance figures are self-reported.
friendlyWhyItMatters: It shows a useful way to build work agents: let AI explain and suggest, but use normal code for maths and keep people in charge of changes.
